title: Door-state gated background learning for thermal occupancy sensors
abstract: Background learning runs only when the door is closed and no motion has been seen for a quiet period.
description: A ceiling thermal sensor in a room fitted with a door state sensor maintains a background estimate. The background update is suspended unless the door state sensor reports the door closed and the motion detector has reported no motion for a quiet period of between 10 and 30 minutes, so that a stationary occupant is not absorbed into the background.

claims.text: A method of maintaining a background estimate for a thermal occupancy sensor in a room having a door state sensor, comprising: updating the background estimate only when the door state sensor reports the door closed and a motion detector has reported no motion for a quiet period.
The method of claim 1, wherein the quiet period is between 10 and 30 minutes.
